name: craftwire

tools.name: list_instances
tools.description: List connected Minecraft clients and servers (id, name, versions, tools added by plugins or mods). Call this first.

tools.name: get_request_status
tools.description: Status of a request sent with an operationId: unknown, running, done (with result) or failed (with error). Kept 5 minutes.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Wait until something happens (after the call). Events: chat_match, hud_match, screen_open, screen_closed, log_match, player_join {pattern}, resource_pack (a client's server pack loaded or failed; pattern on status), server_switch (proxy; pattern on "Bob lobby -> games"). Server, every tick: block, player_near, inventory, event, message, expr {js}. Returns what held and its value. Details: craftwire://docs/tools.

tools.name: player_state
tools.description: Local player: position, rotation, health, game mode, dimension, hotbar slot, inventory, crosshair target.

tools.name: hud_read
tools.description: Read the HUD as text: bossbars, actionbar, title, sidebar (lines as drawn), tab list (header, footer, players), belowName.

tools.name: gui_read
tools.description: Describe the open screen: title, slots (item, count, name, lore), hovered tooltip, widgets. {open:false} when none is open.

tools.name: gui_action
tools.description: Act on the open screen. Slots: click {slot, click; key for number; slots, button for drag}, hover, drag {slot,toSlot}; helpers move_item {from,to,count}, transfer {from:container|inventory,item,count}, equip {slot|item,to}; widgets: click_widget {widget}, type {text}, close; the special screens as in bot_action (fields: craftwire://docs/tools). Returns the new gui_read.

tools.name: input
tools.description: Gameplay input with no screen open: keys (forward, back, left, right, jump, sneak, sprint, attack, use, pick, drop, inventory, swap_hands, chat, command, ...) with mode press|hold|release; look adds yaw/pitch; hotbar 1-9.

tools.name: camera
tools.description: Move the render camera, not the player: set, look_at {target}, frame_area {area}, frame_entity {entity}, freecam_on/off, reset; path {keyframes}/orbit {center,radius} play over time. Details: craftwire://docs/video.

tools.name: client_settings
tools.description: Read or set guiScale, fov, renderDistance, hideHud, windowSize; no arguments only reads.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Capture the game frame. hud/chat:false hide them; maxSize: long edge; savePath writes full size (.png/.jpg); camera: this shot only. layer gui|tooltip|gui+tooltip: transparent PNG of the open menu (craftwire://docs/gui-capture).

tools.name: record
tools.description: Record a video with sound through the user's ffmpeg. start {savePath, preset max|high|balanced|light, durationMs?, camera? (a camera tool path/orbit motion), wait?}; stop; status. layer gui|tooltip|gui+tooltip: transparent .mov/.webm. Encoding options (fps, resolution, codec, crf, …): craftwire://docs/video.

tools.name: chat
tools.description: send {text}; command {text}; read recent chat and actionbar lines (contains?, since?).

tools.name: server_command
tools.description: Run a console command (or asPlayer) and return its feedback, including plugin messages within collectMs. Use the minecraft: prefix when a plugin overrides a vanilla command.

tools.name: server_eval
tools.description: Run JavaScript on the server with the Bukkit/Paper API: server, player(name), plugin(name), loc(x,y,z), Java.type, print. Returns the last value and printed output; globals persist until reset. Folia: pass at or asPlayer to touch blocks, entities or players. Not for building: use build.

at.description: Folia: run on the region of this position.

asPlayer.description: Folia: run on this player's thread.

tools.name: world_query
tools.description: Read the world: block {x,y,z}; region {min,max}: palette + runs (max 32768), encoding 'indices', or 'layers' (a letter per block, max 65536, for build's layers()); entities {min,max,type?}; players; find_block {block,min,max}.

tools.name: world_render
tools.description: Draw a region of a Paper world, no client needed: top (map), slice {y} (floor plan), side {facing}, iso {corner}/iso4 (3D, size px). Up to 512x512 blocks; scale px/block; grid N labels coordinates; savePath writes the PNG.

tools.name: world_edit
tools.description: Change blocks: set_blocks [{x,y,z,block}] (max 10000), fill {min,max,block,replace?}, snapshot/restore {id}, save_schematic/paste_schematic {name,at, rotation?, mirror?, includeEntities?, physics?}. Over 32768 blocks a snapshot is taken first. For more than a few hundred blocks use build.

tools.name: events
tools.description: Bukkit events the server fired (cancelled = final outcome): summary {since?}, query {type?,player?,since?,cancelledOnly?}, listeners {type} (who listens, priority, ignoreCancelled), watch {types} (record busy events too).

type.description: Event class, simple or full name.

tools.name: server_info
tools.description: Server health: TPS, MSPT, memory, versions, players, worlds, plugins; on Folia per-region TPS.

tools.name: plugin_manage
tools.description: list plugins; info {name}; enable/disable {name} for quick checks (not on Folia: use plugin_deploy).

tools.name: build
tools.description: Build from a script file of part(name, () => {...}) blocks (fill, hollow, walls, sphere, cylinder, roof, layers, mix, rotate, mirror...): build {project, file}. After editing the file call it again: only changed blocks are written. A new project needs origin. preview 'iso4': four corner views in one image. Guide: craftwire://docs/building.

file.description: Script path, relative to the hub's working directory.

part.description: Run only this part of the file.

tools.name: build_manage
tools.description: Manage build projects: list; undo {project, steps} (last runs); remove {project, part} (what was under returns); clear {project} (world as before the project); move {project, origin?, rotation?, mirror?}; commit {project} (keep blocks, drop undo history).

tools.name: logs
tools.description: Recent log lines of a server (default) or client, oldest first, stack traces folded in. Filter: level, contains, since.

tools.name: exceptions
tools.description: Exceptions the server and clients logged, grouped into bugs, newest first: type, message, count, origin, plugin; Folia thread hints. id: one bug's full stack; since filters.

id.description: A bug id: returns its full stack.

tools.name: server_process
tools.description: Start, stop, restart or status of a local Paper server run by the hub. JVM flags and jar come from start.bat/start.sh unless given. Never accept the EULA for the user. A server started elsewhere needs takeOver:true (ask first).

serverDir.description: Server folder; optional with one known server.

takeOver.description: Stop a server started outside Craftwire (ask the user first).

tools.name: plugin_deploy
tools.description: Build a plugin project (Gradle or Maven) or take a jar, install it, restart the server and report loaded + problems (its WARN/ERROR lines). BUILD_FAILED lists errors as file:line.

buildCommand.description: Command run in projectDir instead of the detected build.

serverDir.description: Server folder; optional with one known server.

takeOver.description: Stop a server started outside Craftwire (ask the user first).

tools.name: bot_spawn
tools.description: Spawn bots that plugins treat as real players. kind: plugin (fake player in a Paper server, default), java or bedrock (protocol clients from a bot runner; need address). Up to 1000 per call; group names them. Returns {spawned, names:"Bot1..Bot50"}. More (perTick, spread, profile, settings, netsim, auth, …): craftwire://docs/tools.

tools.name: bot_remove
tools.description: Remove bots: bot, bots (names or a pattern), group, or all:true. Returns the count (names:true lists them).

tools.name: bot_list
tools.description: List bots of every kind (or by bot, bots pattern, group, kind): count, joining, and a summary per bot (name, kind, group, position).

tools.name: bot_action
tools.description: Drive bots like real clients (plugins see the same events): one bot, or many by bots (names, pattern) or group. Menus: gui_read, gui_click {slot, click; key for number; slots, button for drag}, move_item, transfer, equip, special screens. Other fields per action: craftwire://docs/tools.

tools.name: botrunner_process
tools.description: Start, stop or status of a bot runner on this machine: the process that runs java and bedrock bots (bot_spawn kind java|bedrock). Runners on other machines connect by themselves with the hub token. start returns the runner's instance.

tools.name: profile
tools.description: Sample a server tick or client frame for durationMs and show who uses the time: owners (plugin or mod), entryPoints (listener, task), hotMethods; server tick stats or client fps. Run it while the slow thing happens, then trace.

tools.name: trace
tools.description: Time every call of methods for durationMs without changing code: method = Class::method, Class or @Annotation (';' for several). Returns counts, avg/max ms, slowest calls with stacks, callers.

tools.name: client_eval
tools.description: Run JavaScript on a client's render thread: mc, player, level, screen(), print, Java.type. The first call downloads GraalJS (~60 MB). Keep scripts short: the game does not render meanwhile.

tools.name: scenario_run
tools.description: Run test scenarios (scenario inline, or files *.cwtest.json): setup, steps (tool calls, bot actions, commands, waits) with expect checks, cleanup. Stops at the first failure and reports the context. Format: craftwire://docs/scenarios.

tools.name: more_tools
tools.description: Turn on tools kept off to save tokens: bot_behavior, load_test, profile_diff, dupe_hunt, locale_tour, scenario_record, bedrock_client. enable: their names, or "all".

tools.name: client_process
tools.description: Hidden clients run by the hub (up to 4): start joins server (host:port; default: the server_process one) or opens world {name, create?} and returns its instance; stop (username, or all); status. lite: small and frameless, for several clients. Online servers: sign_in (Microsoft device code), then start {account}. mod_profile {name, mods} for start {modProfile}. More (mods, windowSize, java, …): craftwire://docs/tools. First start downloads ~150 MB.

instructions: Craftwire lets you see and drive Minecraft. Start with list_instances. Client tools (screenshot, record, camera, gui_*, input, chat, hud_read, player_state, client_settings) act on a game client. Server tools (server_command, server_eval, world_query, world_edit, world_render, server_info, plugin_manage, events) act on a Paper server running the Craftwire plugin; logs reads either, exceptions groups the stack traces of both into bugs. Dev loop: server_process starts/stops a local Paper server; plugin_deploy builds a plugin project (or takes a jar), installs it, restarts the server and reports whether it enabled. scenario_run runs plugin tests written as JSON steps (bots, commands, checks) and reports the failing step with context. No game open? client_process starts a hidden client the hub runs itself (offline mode, for dev servers); then use the client tools on it. Bots: bot_spawn puts bots on a server: kind plugin (in-server fake players, default), java or bedrock (protocol clients from a bot runner); bot_action drives them (chat, command, move_to with pathfinding, every menu click, special screens, use, attack, …) one at a time or by group; bot_remove when done. Off until more_tools turns them on (to save tokens): bot_behavior (bots keep busy on their own), load_test (ramp bots up, profile each step), dupe_hunt (item-dupe click sequences), locale_tour (untranslated texts), scenario_record (a session's calls as a scenario), profile_diff. A Velocity proxy with the Craftwire plugin adds the proxy tool (servers, players, send, commands). Lag and slow code: profile samples a server's tick or a client's frame and names the plugin or mod, listener and method that use the time; trace times every call of a named method. client_eval runs JavaScript on a client (mods, client state). Resources: craftwire://instances, craftwire://exceptions, craftwire://instances/{name}/log (and /chat, /screenshot on clients), craftwire://docs/{tools,building,scenarios,video,extensions,http,folia,bots,velocity,docker,ci}. Prompts: test_plugin, debug_lag, write_scenario, setup. After an action that opens a menu (e.g. chat {action:'command'}), call wait_for {condition:'screen_open'} before gui_read. wait_for also waits on the server (a block, a player arriving, items, an event, a bot's message) instead of sleeping and polling. Every tool takes optional instance (id or name from list_instances; needed only when several match) and operationId (an idempotency key: a retry with the same id returns the first result). Errors carry a `hint` with the next step.
